'''Uncle Li''' is an [[NPC]] in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

He is located to the far right of Panhua's Restaurant in Jinzhou, behind a table with four customers. You can only see him at '''daytime'''.  

Players can learn the recipe for [[Clear Soup]] by interacting with him.

During the event [[By Moon's Grace]], Uncle Li is a shop NPC in [[Taoyuan Vale]] for [[Yumyum Haven]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Uncle Li:''' Oh my! {{MC|m=Young man|f=Young lady}}, you look worn from travel. Are you here to eat, or heading somewhere else?
:{{DIcon}} Gourmet Rumors
::'''Uncle Li:''' Second-rate cooks might make a broth that tastes good on first sip, but lacks richness of flavor after a while.
::'''Uncle Li:''' Don't underestimate that pinch of [[sugar]]. It makes all the difference in the taste and depth of flavor!
::'''Uncle Li:''' That's why you asked me. I don't share this with just anyone.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Uncle Li:''' As someone who's dined at many restaurants, I can say Panhua's Restaurant is the best!
::'''Uncle Li:''' Just look at this food, taste it! If I could, I'd eat here every day!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave 
{{Dialogue End}}
===Event Dialogue===
====By Moon's Grace====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Uncle Li''': ...Peel the shring, leave the tails, coat them all with bean flour... Once that's done, arrange them in the shape of a fan...
::{{DIcon}} What are you making?
::{{DIcon}} Shrimp Tails?
::'''Uncle Li''': Oh, look who's here! Good to see you, {{Rover}}. Been hearing all about your adventures at the tea house. Must be pretty busy, huh?
::'''Uncle Li''': See what I'm making? It's a secret, ancient recipe! This one's called Shrimp Fan.
::'''Uncle Li''': See this? They're all handwritten recipes I've collected from people. Careful! The paper's thin.
::'''Uncle Li''': I tavelled the world collecting them when I was young man. As a gourmet, I can never refuse a delicacy.
::'''Uncle Li''': Since we're celebrating the festival now, I thought it would be nice to whip up some new dishes.
::'''Uncle Li''': Panhua and Mahe have their own business to attend to and can't be here in person, so I brought some of their dishes along.
::{{DIcon}} Some are new to me.
::'''Uncle Li''': Heh! Those are mine.
::'''Uncle Li''': Not bad, hm? I prefer eating over cooking, but it doesn't mean I can't cook.
::'''Uncle Li''': Golden Sesame Tofu, Roasted Stuffed Chicken, Osmanthus Pork Stew... All traditional dishes! Try some, won't you?
----
:'''Uncle Li''': Welcome! What can I get you? You can't enjoy the festival with an empty belly.
:{{DIcon|Shop}} See Yumyum Haven menu
:;(Opens [[shop]])
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Uncle Li''': Back in my Pioneer Association days, I was quite the young adventurer.
::'''Uncle Li''': But as time flew by, I settled down here in Jinzhou. Life's good now, but sometimes I find myself dreaming about all the wonderful places I once explored.
::'''Uncle Li''': Even in the furthest of lands, there's people. And where there's people, there's food.
::'''Uncle Li''': Take the different regions of Huanglong, for instance—no [[Wuthercake]] is the same. They've each got their own unique taste!
::'''Uncle Li''': Try this one. It's the Jinhzhou Wuthercake! It's authentic, I promise.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
